page.notes: Hebrew letters and vowel points are uncertain throughout, especially in the right column and at the running heads; they are marked [?] where I could not read them with confidence. The page number at top right is faint. The Hebrew of the header letters and some roots (R. כּוּם, R. יָגָה) may be misread. Line-end hyphens in "adduc-ti" and "ex-ram" are as printed. The line "מוֹ illis..." ends with an unclear word after "vel".
